== Japanese printed face ==
Full collector photograph visually transcribed and compared with the English printed face. The Japanese grants immunity to attrition less than 3; the English grants immunity to attrition of exactly 3. The Japanese says to target a character not on Tatooine, without the English restriction “one of your characters.” The Japanese uses location card where the English specifies a site. The Japanese lore describes moisture in the environment, rather than the English “exhaled moisture.” Publication ID 1301_67o follows the approved Japanese catalog; this is not a GEMP implementation claim.
